summary: The task succeeded using the existing economic-time-series-analysis skill. The trace reveals two important patterns not yet captured: (1) alias-based series matching via a catalog file (series_aliases.csv), which is a variant of catalog-driven extraction but with accepted aliases rather than code mappings, and (2) priority-based deduplication where lower priority values indicate preferred records. The existing skill covers status flags, matrix formats, and HP filtering well, but lacks guidance on alias matching and priority-based selection. Adding these patterns to the existing skill will help future agents handle similar tasks without trial and error.
